description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which extends the Fragment class from the Android support library. It represents a UI component that contains a custom LogView within a ScrollView, used to display log messages. The class manages the creation and configuration of its view hierarchy, including setting padding, typeface, and text appearance, and it handles auto-scrolling behavior when text is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a log view inside a ScrollView, supporting text output and auto-scrolling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and a custom LogView, setting layout parameters, typeface, padding, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy and adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log when new text is added.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
